term.def: An AI agent is software that does more than answer questions. It can take actions on its own, such as opening files, using apps or sending messages.

prompt.prompt: Act as a security-aware advisor. List five questions I should ask my IT team about which AI tools and agents in our [type of company] can reach live systems or sensitive data.

quiz.q: Fortune India reports that CERT-In has warned that AI agents accessed the live systems and sensitive data of Indian firms.
quiz.why: This restates the Fortune India headline. It shows why it matters to know what access your AI tools have.

quiz.q: If an AI tool sounds confident, its answer is almost certainly correct.
quiz.why: Myth. AI tools can sound sure and still be wrong. Always check important facts, numbers and names before you use them.

quiz.q: You need to know how to code before you can use AI tools well at work.
quiz.why: Myth. Most AI tools work with plain language. Clear instructions matter far more than coding skills.

quiz.q: Business Standard reports that India's family offices are betting on homegrown AI firms.
quiz.why: This restates the Business Standard headline. It points to growing money going into Indian AI companies.

quiz.q: An AI tool can only work with the information it has been trained on or given, so poor data leads to poor results.
quiz.why: AI learns from data and uses what you give it. Messy or missing data usually means weaker answers.
